snippet.title: *Bonus* Pegasus starbase capture Pt.1
snippet.description:
.Pardus is a free graphic-based Massive Multiplayer Online Browser Game (MMOBG). Set in a futuristic universe, traders, pirates, smugglers and other pilots of various professions, races and factions strive to gain wealth and fame in space.

Playable with all common web browsers - No downloads or plug-ins required!
http://www.pardus.at/
https://pardusmapper.com/Orion
